## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and why the change is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] Browser behavior checked when the change affects Chrome integration or UI

## Privacy and permissions

- [ ] No new Chrome permissions, content scripts, network access, telemetry, or
      remote code
- [ ] Documentation reflects any intentional boundary change

## Screenshots

Add screenshots for visible interface changes after removing private information.
